post.author: Christine Gwinnup
post.body:
If you’re thinking about selling your home in Northern Colorado, you’ve likely heard the traditional advice: put a sign in the yard, list it on the MLS, and wait. But in today’s competitive market, that’s not enough to get your home sold quickly and for top dollar. That’s where my BOLD Edge Marketing Plan comes in—a strategy designed to maximize your home’s exposure and attract serious buyers.

What is the BOLD Edge Marketing Plan?

The BOLD Edge Marketing Plan is my proprietary approach to selling homes, combining traditional methods with cutting-edge digital marketing techniques. It’s all about getting your home noticed by the right people, at the right time.

Key Elements of the BOLD Edge Marketing Plan

Here’s how I ensure your home stands out in the crowded real estate market:

  • Billboards: High-visibility billboards in strategic locations capture the attention of potential buyers as they go about their day.
  • Digital Ads: Targeted online ads reach buyers where they’re already searching—on Google, social media, and popular real estate websites.
  • Social Media Campaigns: By leveraging platforms like Facebook and Instagram, I create engaging content that showcases your home to a wide audience.
  • SEO and Video Content: High-quality video tours and SEO-optimized content ensure your home ranks well in search results, driving more traffic to your listing.

Why Choose the BOLD Edge Marketing Plan?

In today’s fast-paced market, you need more than just a “for sale” sign to get your home noticed. My BOLD Edge Marketing Plan is designed to create buzz and attract multiple offers, leading to a quicker sale and a higher selling price. Plus, with personalized service and deep local market knowledge, I ensure your unique needs are met every step of the way.

Success Stories

I’ve helped numerous clients sell their homes quickly and for top dollar, from luxury estates in Loveland to investment properties in Greeley. No matter the property, the BOLD Edge Marketing Plan delivers results.

Ready to sell your home? Let’s discuss how my BOLD Edge Marketing Plan can work for you. Contact me today to get started or learn more here!
